rationale: Composite is weak short (36.3%) and the evidence is genuinely conflicted: 1h/1d lean short but 4h and 30m are flat, while daily RSI is deeply oversold (14.5) with bullish daily divergence and price pinned at the lower Bollinger band (%B 0.015) on support (1.0392). With the most-negative funding (-0.00023) and the most lopsided long crowd (L/S 3.77) of the three, fresh shorts face the highest squeeze risk on any BTC relief bounce, and ETF inflows plus the July-1 escrow non-event remove downside conviction. At market (1.0411), the short to support is only ~0.18% versus a stop beyond resistance/1x ATR, giving sub-1:1 R:R — far below the 1.5:1 threshold — so this is a textbook stand-aside.
risk_note: Lopsided-long crowd + most-negative funding + oversold/divergent daily = high short-squeeze risk on any BTC bounce, with near-zero room down to support.
